name: outputvars-simple
note: The bespoke `<<<name … <<<` outputVars fence. In a STANDALONE page (no atlas frontmatter) the JS `outputVars` node survives every remark pass and renders through `mdast-util-to-hast`'s unknown handler as a `<div>` wrapping the captured code blocks (`mdComposer`'s `file.data.outputVars` examples blob feeds only the atlas meta-component — a source-backed page that falls back — so it has no rendered-HTML effect here). The Rust port (fork `output_vars_container` construct + `output_vars` transform) reproduces that `<div>`; parity.rs enforces rendered.html since compile_mdx returns `full`.
